observations.text: The GSEM paper represents experience with an explicit applicable-condition context c_i and an indication/contraindication polarity z_i, and motivates Boundary Failure as transfer based on partial condition match that ignores critical applicability boundaries. Its retrieval ablation reports GSEM at 94.22/94.59/34 versus w/o entity recall 92.71/92.57/24, w/o embedding recall 93.62/83.78/10, and w/o multi-seed retrieval 91.79/92.57/23 on the three reported retrieval-quality columns.

In the current public paper-linked implementation, the graph traversal prompt asks an LLM to compare each node's condition/context with the clinical query and COLLECT when it is relevant or partially relevant. It also states that at least one experience must be collected before stopping. This is an LLM relevance judgment, not an inspectable mandatory predicate proving that all applicability/boundary conditions are satisfied.

The current public multi-start retriever is explicitly fail-open after rejection: if a traversal path selects no experience, it automatically records the starting node before merging results. Thus, once a valid start seed exists, a path cannot preserve the receiver's empty/no-applicable-memory result; the seed is injected even after no node was selected.

The same repository contains an explicit GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent ablation variant described as multi-start traversal without per-start fallback-to-start. The inspected paper retrieval-ablation table does not report this no-fill factor, and no numeric no-fill result was established in the checked current public surfaces. Therefore the causal performance/safety effect of removing forced backfill remains unresolved.

protocol_inferences.name: APPLICABILITY_GATE_MUST_PRESERVE_ABSTENTION
protocol_inferences.text: If receiver-side applicability/revalidation rejects or holds every candidate, runtime selection must be allowed to remain empty. A fallback that forcibly injects one candidate after all candidates fail admission converts uncertainty/rejection into action authority and invalidates the claimed gate.

protocol_inferences.name: RELEVANCE_IS_NOT_APPLICABILITY
protocol_inferences.text: A relevance or partial-relevance LLM decision can nominate candidates, but it must not be treated as proof that explicit boundary/contraindication predicates have been satisfied.

phase1_acceptance.reason: GSEM is strong science-domain evidence for context-aware experience selection, but the checked current implementation depends on LLM retrieval decisions and contains forced fallback-to-start; it is not a zero-dependency fail-closed scheduled-Chat replay mechanism.

scope_notes: The forced-backfill conclusion is about the checked current public implementation linked by the paper; the exact evaluated paper revision is not yet bound.
The paper's reported benchmark results are not invalidated by the current-code observation.
Absence of a numeric no-fill result is limited to the inspected paper table/current public surfaces; it is not a global absence claim.
